cohort: The study cohort consisted of 11 pregnant women with pre-existing type 2 diabetes mellitus and 28 pregnant normoglycaemic controls.
finding: Using a consensus approach for differential abundance analysis, few differences were identified in the oral microbiome between pregnant women with and without pre-existing T2DM, though specific taxa and diversity measures showed differences at the late gestational time point.
cross-section timing: Two time points between 26 and 38 weeks of gestation
